description: This file defines the class tlTestCaseFilterControl, which extends tlFilterControl. It manages filters and settings for test cases within the TestLink project, including initialization of various filters, session management, and tree building for GUI representation. The class contains extensive logic for handling different modes (edit, execution, plan, plan add), user input parsing, and session data management.

classes.name: tlTestCaseFilterControl
classes.description: Class managing test case filters and settings, with session management and tree-building capabilities for GUI interaction in TestLink.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing filters, mode, session data, and tree options based on provided mode.

methods.name: read_config
methods.description: Reads configuration related to test case filters from config files.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Parses user input from request and manages form token generation.

methods.name: init_settings
methods.description: Initializes all filter and setting options based on mode and configuration.

methods.name: init_filters
methods.description: Sets up filter parameters and active filters based on configuration and mode.

methods.name: get_active_filters
methods.description: Returns current user-selected filter values either as array or object depending on mode.

methods.name: set_testcases_to_show
methods.description: Updates internal list of test cases to display and saves session data.

methods.name: build_tree_menu
methods.description: Constructs the test case tree for GUI based on current filters and mode.

methods.name: save_session_data
methods.description: Stores current filter settings into session, identified by form token.

methods.name: delete_old_session_data
methods.description: Removes session data older than a specified duration to prevent clutter.

methods.name: delete_own_session_data
methods.description: Removes session data related to the current form token.

methods.name: generate_form_token
methods.description: Creates a new form token for session identification.

methods.name: get_argument_string
methods.description: Generates URL query string with current filter and setting parameters.
